title: Listening: maps and directions
subtitle: IELTS Listening Part 2 plan / map labelling

items.explanation: The direction towards the top of a map, unless the map shows north somewhere else.
items.speakerLine: The boathouse is at the north end of the park, right on the edge of the lake.

items.explanation: The direction towards the bottom of the map; the opposite of north.
items.speakerLine: The car park is in the south of the site, very close to the main gate.

items.explanation: The direction towards the right-hand side of a map when north is at the top.
items.speakerLine: Head east along that path and you'll come to the bike hire at the very end.

items.explanation: The direction towards the left-hand side of a map when north is at the top.
items.speakerLine: The first-aid post is just west of the visitor centre, on the same side of the path.

items.explanation: Halfway between north and east: towards the top right-hand part of the map.
items.speakerLine: The lake is in the north-east of the park, so head that way if you want to hire a boat.

items.explanation: Halfway between north and west: towards the top left-hand part of the map.
items.speakerLine: The woodland is in the north-west, and the bird hide is tucked away right in the middle of it.

items.explanation: Halfway between south and east: towards the bottom right-hand part of the map.
items.speakerLine: The walled garden is in the south-east of the park, just behind the gift shop.

items.explanation: Halfway between south and west: towards the bottom left-hand part of the map.
items.speakerLine: The car park is in the south-west corner, so if you come by car you'll arrive that way.

items.explanation: Inside the place, in its top half, not outside it to the north.
items.speakerLine: The picnic tables are in the northern part of the garden, where there's a bit more shade.

items.explanation: Outside something, on its east side. It may be close to it or some distance away.
items.speakerLine: The bandstand is to the east of the main path, standing on its own in the open grass.

items.explanation: A short distance outside something, on its north side.
items.speakerLine: The boathouse is just north of the path, right at the water's edge.

items.explanation: Outside something, on its south side, towards the bottom of the map.
items.speakerLine: The gift shop is directly south of the café, so it's the first building you'll pass on the right.

items.explanation: The top left-hand corner of a room, building or area on the map.
items.speakerLine: The cloakroom is in the north-west corner of the lobby, right next to the lifts.

items.explanation: Moving round something in the same direction as the hands of a clock.
items.speakerLine: If you walk clockwise round the lake, the jetty is the first thing you'll come to.

items.explanation: Moving round in the opposite direction to a clock's hands. American English: counterclockwise.
items.speakerLine: Go anticlockwise round the pond and you'll pass the bird hide before you reach the bridge.

items.explanation: Facing it, on the other side of a road, path or open space.
items.speakerLine: You'll find the gift shop directly opposite the ticket office, on the other side of the path.

items.explanation: Side by side with something, with nothing else in between.
items.speakerLine: The first-aid post is right next to the visitor centre, so it's very easy to find.

items.explanation: A formal way of saying "next to"; often used for rooms that share a wall.
items.speakerLine: The staffroom is adjacent to the main office, so staff can go straight through.

items.explanation: With one thing on one side and another thing on the other side.
items.speakerLine: The nature centre sits between the woodland and the lake, at the top of the main path.

items.explanation: Near the front or entrance side of something, where you see it first.
items.speakerLine: There's a bike rack in front of the visitor centre, just by the main doors.

items.explanation: At the back of something, on the side away from the path or entrance.
items.speakerLine: The staff car park is behind the main building, so you can't see it from the road.

items.explanation: At the end that is furthest from you or from where you started.
items.speakerLine: The café is at the far end of the corridor, just past the lecture theatre.

items.explanation: Where two sides or walls meet, or where a path turns sharply.
items.speakerLine: The adventure playground is in the corner where the path bends round to the right.

items.explanation: On the left of the direction you are walking in, not the left of the map.
items.speakerLine: As you walk in, the ticket office is on your left-hand side, next to the car park.

items.explanation: On the right of the direction you are walking in, not the right of the map.
items.speakerLine: Just past the crossroads, you'll see the toilets on your right-hand side.

items.explanation: A little after something, once you have walked by it.
items.speakerLine: The toilets are just past the crossroads, so once you've crossed over, you're nearly there.

items.explanation: Further on than something, on the other side of it from you.
items.speakerLine: Beyond the bridge, the path gets quite narrow, so do take care with small children.

items.explanation: A little before something, so you reach it first.
items.speakerLine: The information point is just before the T-junction, so you'll see it before you have to turn.

items.explanation: Next to something and running in the same direction along its length.
items.speakerLine: A narrow footpath runs alongside the river, all the way from the mill to the bridge.

items.explanation: With something on every side of it.
items.speakerLine: The bird hide is surrounded by trees, so it's quite hard to spot from the path.

items.term: in the middle / in the centre
items.explanation: At the central point, the same distance from all the sides.
items.speakerLine: The fountain is right in the middle of the square, so everyone uses it as a meeting point.

items.explanation: At the point where two roads or paths meet or cross.
items.speakerLine: The café stands at the junction of the main path and the east path, on the south side.

items.explanation: Across a junction or square, on the corner furthest away, not straight across.
items.speakerLine: The picnic shelter is diagonally opposite the café, on the far corner of the crossroads.

items.explanation: Within a building, room or area, not outside it.
items.speakerLine: The information desk is inside the main building, just to the left as you come in.

items.explanation: Keep walking in the same direction without turning.
items.speakerLine: From the main gate, go straight on until you get to the crossroads.

items.explanation: Keep going along the same path or road for a while longer.
items.speakerLine: Carry on along this path for a few minutes and you'll see the boathouse on your left.

items.explanation: Change direction to your own left, whichever way you are facing on the map.
items.speakerLine: When you get to the T-junction, turn left and walk towards the woods.

items.explanation: Change direction to your own right, whichever way you are facing on the map.
items.speakerLine: Turn right at the crossroads, and the bike hire is at the end of that path.

items.term: take the second turning on the left
items.explanation: Walk past the first path on your left and turn into the next one.
items.speakerLine: Take the second turning on the left, not the first one, or you'll end up in the car park.

items.explanation: Turn right into the first path or road you come to on that side.
items.speakerLine: Take the first right after the gate, and the reception building is straight in front of you.

items.explanation: Walk in the direction of something you can see.
items.speakerLine: From the café, head towards the lake and you'll find the boathouse on the shore.

items.explanation: Go from one side of a road, path or river to the other side.
items.speakerLine: Cross over the road at the lights, and the museum entrance is right in front of you.

items.explanation: Keep on the path where it curves or bends, turning as it turns.
items.speakerLine: Follow the path round to the right, and it'll bring you out by the woods.

items.explanation: Pass from one side of the gate to the other, into the next area.
items.speakerLine: Go through the little gate in the fence, and the vegetable garden is on your left.

items.explanation: Walk by something without stopping or turning there.
items.speakerLine: Go past the toilets, and the information point is the next building on your right.

items.term: as far as / until you reach
items.explanation: Walk until you reach that point, and then stop or change direction.
items.speakerLine: Walk as far as the T-junction, and then you'll need to decide which way to go.

items.explanation: Turn round and go back the way you have just come.
items.speakerLine: If you get to the bridge, you've gone too far, so you'll need to double back.

items.explanation: Climb the stairs to a higher floor.
items.speakerLine: Go up the stairs to the first floor, and the reading room is straight ahead.

items.explanation: Move to a lower level: down stairs, a slope or a hill.
items.speakerLine: Go down the steps towards the river, and the ticket office is at the bottom.

items.explanation: A place where two roads or paths cross, so you can go four ways.
items.speakerLine: At the crossroads, turn left, and the visitor centre is on the corner.

items.explanation: Where one path ends at another path, making a T shape. You must turn left or right.
items.speakerLine: The main path ends at a T-junction, and the nature centre is straight in front of you.

items.explanation: A circular junction; traffic goes round it and turns off onto another road.
items.speakerLine: At the roundabout, take the second exit, and the sports centre is on your left.

items.explanation: A place where a road or path curves or changes direction.
items.speakerLine: Just after the bend in the road, you'll see the old mill on your right.

items.explanation: A place where one path divides into two paths going in different directions.
items.speakerLine: When the path forks, keep to the left, and it'll take you down to the pond.

items.explanation: A narrow path for people walking; cars and usually bikes are not allowed.
items.speakerLine: There's a footpath across the field that takes you straight to the old mill.

items.explanation: A narrow road, usually in the countryside, often with hedges on both sides.
items.speakerLine: The farm shop is about halfway down the lane, on the right, opposite the church.

items.explanation: A rough, unpaved path, often used by farm vehicles, bikes or walkers.
items.speakerLine: The track through the woods can get quite muddy, so wear sensible boots.

items.explanation: A narrow bridge for people walking, over a river, road or railway.
items.speakerLine: Cross the river by the footbridge, and the picnic area is just on the other side.

items.explanation: A marked place on a road where people on foot can cross safely.
items.speakerLine: Use the pedestrian crossing outside the station, and the hotel is directly opposite.

items.explanation: A road or path that stops and goes nowhere; you have to come back the same way.
items.speakerLine: The east path is a dead end, so the bike hire is the only thing down there.

items.explanation: Ground that goes gradually up or down, such as a ramp instead of steps.
items.speakerLine: There's a gentle slope up to the main entrance, so it's fine for wheelchairs and pushchairs.

items.explanation: A short set of stairs outside, for example up a hill or into a building.
items.speakerLine: Take the steps down to the beach; they're just to the left of the lifeguard station.

items.explanation: An opening in a fence, wall or hedge that you can close.
items.speakerLine: Please make sure you close the gate behind you, because there are sheep in the next field.

items.explanation: A barrier of wood or wire that marks the edge of an area.
items.speakerLine: The vegetable garden has a high fence round it to keep the rabbits out.

items.explanation: A line of bushes growing close together, used like a wall around a field or garden.
items.speakerLine: The picnic area is hidden behind a tall hedge, just to the left of the car park.

items.explanation: The way into a building or site; where most visitors come in.
items.speakerLine: The main entrance is on the south side, facing the car park.

items.explanation: The desk or area just inside a building where visitors are welcomed and sign in.
items.speakerLine: When you arrive, please go to reception first to collect your visitor's badge.

items.explanation: An area where people leave their cars. American English: parking lot.
items.speakerLine: The car park is on your left as you come in, so drivers don't need to go far.

items.explanation: The large open area just inside the main door of a building such as a hotel or theatre.
items.speakerLine: We'll meet in the lobby at nine o'clock, next to the big staircase.

items.explanation: A long, narrow passage inside a building, with doors to rooms along it.
items.speakerLine: Walk to the end of the corridor, and the computer room is the last door on the right.

items.explanation: A platform that goes out over water, where boats stop and people can walk.
items.speakerLine: The rowing boats leave from the jetty, which is on the western shore of the lake.

items.explanation: A small area of still water, smaller than a lake.
items.speakerLine: The duck pond is just inside the gate, so it's the first thing the children will see.

items.explanation: An area of land covered with trees; smaller than a forest.
items.speakerLine: The woodland fills the north-west corner of the park, and there's a bird hide hidden inside it.

items.explanation: An outdoor place with tables and benches where people can eat their own food.
items.speakerLine: The picnic area is on the grass beside the pond, with plenty of tables and benches.

items.explanation: A room where you leave your coat and bags while you are in the building.
items.speakerLine: You can leave your coats and bags in the cloakroom, just to the right of the entrance.

items.explanation: The place where you buy tickets before you go in or travel.
items.speakerLine: The ticket office is just inside the main gate, on your left as you come in.

items.explanation: A desk where staff answer questions and give out maps and leaflets.
items.speakerLine: If you get lost, ask at the information desk in the middle of the entrance hall.

items.explanation: A room used for keeping equipment and supplies, not for working in.
items.speakerLine: The storage room is at the back of the hall, behind the stage.

items.explanation: A room where staff take breaks; visitors and students usually cannot go in.
items.speakerLine: The staffroom is on the first floor, directly above the main office.

items.explanation: Rooms with toilets and washbasins. Also called the loos or, on signs, WC.
items.speakerLine: The toilets are just past the crossroads on the right, just south of the information point.

items.explanation: A small moving room that carries people between floors. American English: elevator.
items.speakerLine: The lift is at the far end of the lobby, just beyond the stairs.

items.explanation: A set of steps inside a building going from one floor to another.
items.speakerLine: Take the stairs to the second floor; the lift is out of order this morning.

items.explanation: The speaker changes the answer. Always write the last version you hear.
items.speakerLine: The café is on the left of the lobby – oh, sorry, I mean on the right.

items.term: "Not the first building, but the one after it"
items.explanation: The first place mentioned is a distractor; count carefully to the building meant.
items.speakerLine: It isn't the first building you come to – the gift shop is the one after that.

items.explanation: Opposite means across a space, facing it. Next to means on the same side, touching.
items.speakerLine: The toilets aren't next to the café – they're opposite it, on the other side of the path.

items.explanation: Before means you reach it first; past means you have already gone by the landmark.
items.speakerLine: The picnic area is just past the bridge, not before it, so do cross over first.

items.term: "North of the lake" vs "the north side of the lake"
items.explanation: North of: outside it, some way off. North side of: on its northern edge or shore.
items.speakerLine: The bird hide is on the north side of the lake, right at the water's edge.

items.explanation: Go past the landmark and keep walking that distance; the place is not at the landmark.
items.speakerLine: When you reach the fountain, the shop is about fifty metres further on, on the same side.

items.term: The walker's left vs the map's left
items.explanation: Left and right depend on which way you walk. Walking south, your left is east on the map.
items.speakerLine: As you walk down from the car park, the lake is on your left, so that's the east side.

items.term: "Not the first turning, but the second"
items.explanation: The speaker rules out one choice before giving the real one. Count the turnings carefully.
items.speakerLine: Don't take the first turning on the right – that just goes to the staff car park. Take the second.

buildings.label: Ticket office
buildings.locate: The ticket office is just inside the main gate, on your left as you walk in, next to the car park.

buildings.label: Visitor centre
buildings.locate: The visitor centre is on the south-west corner of the crossroads, directly opposite the café.

buildings.label: Café
buildings.locate: The café is on the south-east corner of the crossroads, opposite the visitor centre and directly north of the gift shop.

buildings.label: Toilets
buildings.locate: The toilets are just past the crossroads on your right-hand side as you walk north along the main path.

buildings.label: Bandstand
buildings.locate: The bandstand stands on its own in the open grass to the east of the main path, north of the east path.

buildings.label: Boathouse
buildings.locate: The boathouse is on the southern shore of the lake, between the water and the north path.

spots.name: Gift shop
spots.locate: Just inside the main gate on your right-hand side, directly opposite the ticket office.

spots.name: First-aid post
spots.locate: On the south side of the west path, next to the visitor centre on its west side and just north of the car park.

spots.name: Bike hire
spots.locate: At the far end of the east path, facing you where the path stops; it is the easternmost building in the park.

spots.name: Picnic shelter
spots.locate: Just past the crossroads on your left as you walk north, directly opposite the toilets and diagonally opposite the café.

spots.name: Adventure playground
spots.locate: In the corner where the west path bends round to join the north path, just south of the woodland.

spots.name: Information point
spots.locate: On the right-hand side of the main path just before the T-junction, directly north of the toilets.

spots.name: Nature centre
spots.locate: Straight ahead at the top of the main path, across the T-junction, between the woodland and the lake.

spots.name: Bird hide
spots.locate: In the middle of the woodland in the north-west of the park, surrounded by trees.

whereIsIt.line: The gift shop is just inside the main gate, directly opposite the ticket office.
whereIsIt.explain: Opposite = facing it across the path. The ticket office is west of the path, so the gift shop is on the east side.

whereIsIt.line: The first-aid post is right next to the visitor centre, on its west side, just north of the car park.
whereIsIt.explain: Next to the visitor centre on the west, with the car park directly to its south.

whereIsIt.line: The bike hire is at the very end of the east path. The path doesn't go any further than that.
whereIsIt.explain: The east path is a dead end; the building at its end is C.

whereIsIt.line: The picnic shelter is just past the crossroads on your left as you walk up from the gate, opposite the toilets.
whereIsIt.explain: Walking north, left is west. Just past the crossroads on the west side, facing the toilets.

whereIsIt.line: The adventure playground is tucked into the corner where the west path bends round and joins the north path.
whereIsIt.explain: The west path turns north and then meets the north path; E sits inside that corner.

whereIsIt.line: The information point is on your right, just before you reach the T-junction at the top of the main path.
whereIsIt.explain: Walking north, right is east. Just before the T-junction = a little south of it.

whereIsIt.line: The nature centre is straight ahead at the end of the main path, across the T-junction, between the woodland and the lake.
whereIsIt.explain: The main path ends at a T-junction; G faces it, with woodland to the west and the lake to the east.

whereIsIt.line: The bird hide is right in the middle of the woodland, surrounded by trees.
whereIsIt.explain: Surrounded by = trees on every side. Only H is inside the woodland.

whereIsIt.line: Diagonally opposite the café, on the far corner of the crossroads, you'll find the picnic shelter.
whereIsIt.explain: The café is on the south-east corner; the diagonally opposite corner is the north-west one.

whereIsIt.line: The information point is directly north of the toilets, on the same side of the main path.
whereIsIt.explain: North = towards the top of the map. The next building up from the toilets on the east side is F.

whereIsIt.line: The bike hire is the building furthest east in the whole park.
whereIsIt.explain: East = the right-hand edge of the map. C is the easternmost building.

whereIsIt.line: The adventure playground is just south of the woodland, on the other side of the north path.
whereIsIt.explain: South of = below it on the map. H is inside the woodland, not south of it.

routes.line: Go straight on from the main gate as far as the crossroads. Turn right there and follow the path to the very end. It's the building facing you.
routes.explain: Walking north, turning right means heading east. The east path is a dead end, and C is at its end.

routes.line: Walk up the main path and go straight over the crossroads. Go past the toilets, and it's the next building on your right.
routes.explain: Walking north, your right is east. After the toilets, the next building on the east side is F.

routes.line: Head up the main path and take the second turning on the left. It's on your left, just before the path bends round to the left.
routes.explain: The first left is at the crossroads, the second is at the T-junction. Walking west, your left is south, so E.

routes.line: Go straight up the main path as far as it goes. Don't turn left or right at the T-junction; the building is right in front of you.
routes.explain: The main path ends at the T-junction, and G faces the end of it.

routes.line: Take the first turning on the left, at the crossroads. Go past the visitor centre, and it's the next building on your left.
routes.explain: Walking north, the first left is the west path. Walking west, your left is south: first the visitor centre, then B.

routes.line: Walk up to the crossroads and cross straight over. It's the first building on your left.
routes.explain: Walking north, your left is west. The first building on that side after the crossroads is D.

traps.line: The café is on the left as you come in – no, sorry, it's on the right.
traps.question: Where is the café?
traps.why: The speaker corrects herself. The last answer is the one that counts.

traps.line: Don't go into the first building you come to. The gift shop is the one after that.
traps.question: Which building is the gift shop?
traps.why: "The one after that" means the next building, so the second.

traps.line: The toilets aren't next to the café. They're opposite it, on the other side of the path.
traps.question: Where are the toilets?
options: across the path from the café
traps.why: Opposite means facing it across the path, not beside it.

traps.line: The picnic area is just past the bridge, so once you've crossed over, you'll see it straight away.
traps.question: Where is the picnic area?
traps.why: Just past = a little after it, once you have crossed.

traps.line: The bird hide isn't north of the lake. It's on the north side of the lake, right at the water's edge.
traps.question: Where is the bird hide?
options: some distance north of the lake
in the middle of the lake
traps.why: North side of the lake = on its northern edge, not away from it.

traps.line: When you get to the fountain, keep going. The shop is about fifty metres further on.
traps.question: Where is the shop?
traps.why: Further on = after the landmark, in the same direction.

traps.line: We're walking south from the car park now, so the lake is on your left.
traps.question: Which side of the map is the lake on?
traps.why: Walking south, your left is east on the map.

traps.line: Don't take the first turning on the right; that only goes to the staff car park. Take the second one.
traps.question: Which turning should you take?
traps.why: The first turning is ruled out. The instruction is the second right.

traps.line: The office used to be by the main entrance, but it's moved, and it's now at the end of the corridor.
traps.question: Where is the office now?
options: at the end of the corridor
traps.why: The first place is where it used to be. Listen for "now".

traps.line: You'll pass the stairs first. The lift is just beyond them, at the far end of the lobby.
traps.question: Where is the lift?
options: just after the stairs, at the far end
traps.why: Beyond = further on. You reach the stairs first, then the lift.
